90080.desc:
长期与自然精魂生活在一起的夜精灵比人类更能忍受元素的伤害，而且有更强的生命力。
随人物等级增加所有魔法抗性，体力上限。

en: Living among the nature spirits, night elves endure the elements better than humans and have greater vitality. All resistances and max HP grow with your level.

90081.desc: 夜精灵能够从敌人身上吸取生命元素，维持他们自己城市的繁华。

90082.desc:
顽强，进取，富有创造力——人类总是在相对短暂的生涯中开创出和其他长命种族相当的事业。

tr: Edilgen: Karanlık Ahit etkinken saldırı aldığında %10 olasılıkla hasarı savuşturur, hasar kadar mana kazanırsın.
en: Passive: during Dark Pact, when hit you have a 10% chance to negate the damage and gain that much mana.

90612.desc: 被动：在受到攻击时有$const(trigger_effect_rate)$%的概率使自身物理防御和全部抗性大幅提升，效果持续6秒。该效果在黑暗契约激活的状态下不能触发，且每15秒只能触发一次。
90612.next: 在受到攻击时有$const_next(trigger_effect_rate)$%的概率使自身物理防御和全部抗性大幅提升。
tr: Edilgen: saldırı aldığında %{trigger_effect_rate} olasılıkla 6 saniye savunman ve dirençlerin çok artar (Karanlık Ahit etkinken olmaz; 15 saniyede bir).
en: Passive: when hit, {trigger_effect_rate}% chance to greatly raise defense and resistances for 6 seconds (not during Dark Pact; once per 15 seconds).

90613.desc: 辅助：幻化出黑暗之翼，使自身的魔法攻击提升30%，自身周围一定范围内的所有目标体力每秒减少1%，效果持续6秒，消耗法力$cost_mp$点，冷却时间$cd$秒。在黑暗之翼状态下，自身的所有治疗和辅助技能都将失效。
90613.next: 使自身的魔法攻击提升32%，消耗法力$cost_mp_next$点。
tr: Destek: kara kanatlar açar: 6 saniye büyü saldırın %30 artar, çevrendeki düşmanlar saniyede canlarının %1'ini kaybeder; bu sürede şifa ve destek becerilerin çalışmaz. {mp} mana, bekleme {cd} sn.
en: Support: spread dark wings: magic attack +30% for 6 seconds and nearby enemies lose 1% of their HP every second; your healing and support skills do not work meanwhile. {mp} mana, cooldown {cd} s.
